title: RuView — Data Health
description: Is the data flowing and trustworthy? Nodes, the CSI source, the bridge, the recorder, the watchdog's checks, why vitals were withheld, and the TimescaleDB tables and jobs.

target.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       concat_ws(' ', tags ->> 'kind', tags ->> 'label', tags ->> 'action', tags ->> 'person')
         || coalesce(': ' || (fields ->> 'text'), '') AS text,
       concat_ws(',', tags ->> 'kind', tags ->> 'source') AS tags
FROM ingest.annotation
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Newest state row
panels.description: Seconds since the newest ruview/state row reached TimescaleDB. The bridge publishes up to 10 rows per second while the sensing server has new ticks. A growing age means the server, the bridge, the bus or Telegraf stopped.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(time)) AS "age"
FROM ingest.state
WHERE time > now() - interval '1 day'

panels.title: Live CSI, last 10 min
panels.description: Share of state rows with a live CSI source (stale_source = 0). While the ESP32 source is offline the server keeps re-sending its last frame; those rows are not live and are left out of every presence, motion and vitals statistic.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(n_live)::float / nullif(sum(n), 0) AS "live"
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE bucket > now() - interval '10 minutes'

panels.title: Fresh nodes
panels.description: ESP32 nodes the server heard from recently, of the nodes it knows (newest state row of the last 5 minutes).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT fresh_nodes AS "fresh", active_nodes AS "known"
FROM ingest.state
WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Watchdog
panels.description: Overall state in the newest watchdog round (docker/analytics), the same as the RuView Watchdog device in Home Assistant.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (fields ->> 'status_level')::int AS "status"
FROM ingest.watchdog
WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Open issues
panels.description: Watchdog checks raised in the newest round; the timeline below shows which.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (fields ->> 'open_issues')::int AS "open issues"
FROM ingest.watchdog
WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Raw CSI recorder
panels.description: Hours of raw CSI in the csi-recorder's ring and the free space on its disk (newest status of the last 5 minutes).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (fields ->> 'ring_hours')::float AS "ring",
       (fields ->> 'disk_free_gb')::float AS "disk free"
FROM ingest.recorder
WHERE time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Watchdog checks
panels.description: One row per watchdog check (docker/analytics): red while the check was raised. A check that is missing had no data to judge (unknown).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
       substr(key, 7) AS metric,
       max(value::float) AS value
FROM ingest.watchdog, jsonb_each_text(fields) AS f(key, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND key LIKE 'check\_%'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: State rows per minute
panels.description: Rows in ruview/state per minute: all, and those with a live CSI source. The bridge writes one row per new server tick, at most 10 per second.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval),
       sum(n)::float / ($__interval_ms / 60000.0) AS "all",
       sum(n_live)::float / ($__interval_ms / 60000.0) AS "live"
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bridge stream
panels.description: What the mqtt-bridge sees from the sensing server, per second (ruview/bridge, every 10 s). Repeated ticks with no new ones mean the server is re-sending its last frame: the CSI source has stalled.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
       avg((fields ->> 'new_ticks_hz')::float) AS "new ticks",
       avg((fields ->> 'duplicates_hz')::float) AS "repeated ticks",
       avg((fields ->> 'state_published_hz')::float) AS "published"
FROM ingest.bridge
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: CSI frames per second
panels.description: Average CSI frame rate per node, from ruview/nodes. Node 1 is in the bedroom, node 2 at the study desk, node 3 beside the living-room sofa.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval),
       'node ' || node_id AS metric,
       sum(csi_fps_avg * n) / nullif(sum(n), 0) AS value
FROM agg.node_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: RSSI
panels.description: Average signal strength per node. Node 1 is in the bedroom, node 2 at the study desk, node 3 beside the living-room sofa.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval),
       'node ' || node_id AS metric,
       sum(rssi_avg * n) / nullif(sum(n), 0) AS value
FROM agg.node_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Node offline share
panels.description: Share of node reports marked stale (the server has not heard from the node recently). Node 1 is in the bedroom, node 2 at the study desk, node 3 beside the living-room sofa.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval),
       'node ' || node_id AS metric,
       sum(stale * n) / nullif(sum(n), 0) AS value
FROM agg.node_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Raw CSI datagrams per node
panels.description: Datagrams per second the csi-recorder receives from each node (ruview/recorder/status, every 30 s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
       'node ' || substring(key FROM '^nodes_(.+)_csi_hz$') AS metric,
       avg(value::float) AS value
FROM ingest.recorder, jsonb_each_text(fields) AS f(key, value)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND key ~ '^nodes_.+_csi_hz$'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recorder ring and disk
panels.description: Hours of raw CSI kept in the ring (at most RING_HOURS) and the free space on the recorder's disk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval),
       avg((fields ->> 'ring_hours')::float) AS "ring",
       avg((fields ->> 'disk_free_gb')::float) AS "disk free"
FROM ingest.recorder
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Why vitals were withheld
panels.description: Minutes with a live CSI source but no published heart rate, by the reason the server gave (the most common reason in each minute).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(abstention_reason, 'none given') AS reason,
       count(*) AS minutes
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND n_live > 0 AND hr_n = 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Vitals published
panels.description: Share of live state rows with a published heart rate and breathing rate, and of rows with a fresh empty-room calibration. Rates are withheld unless exactly one person is in the room, a calibration is fresh and the signal is good.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval),
       sum(hr_n)::float / nullif(sum(n_live), 0) AS "heart rate",
       sum(br_n)::float / nullif(sum(n_live), 0) AS "breathing rate",
       sum(calibration_fresh * n) / nullif(sum(n), 0) AS "calibration fresh"
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Distinct vitals values per minute
panels.description: How many different heart-rate and breathing-rate values were published per minute. One or two over many minutes means frozen values (the September 83.37 / 19.28 incident); the watchdog's Vitals Frozen check watches the same.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket, $__interval, NULL),
       avg(hr_distinct) FILTER (WHERE hr_n > 0) AS "heart rate",
       avg(br_distinct) FILTER (WHERE br_n > 0) AS "breathing rate"
FROM agg.state_1m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rows in the last hour
panels.description: Rows each ingest table received in the last hour, and the age of the newest. A table with no rows means its topic stopped or Telegraf skipped it (docker compose logs telegraf).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'ingest.' || t AS "table", rows, extract(epoch FROM now() - newest) AS "newest"
FROM (
    SELECT 'state' AS t, count(*) AS rows, max(time) AS newest FROM ingest.state WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'node', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.node WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'person', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.person WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'ha_binary', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.ha_binary WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'ha_sensor', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.ha_sensor WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'ha_event', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.ha_event WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'bridge', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.bridge WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'watchdog', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.watchdog WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'recorder', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.recorder WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'recorder_keep', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.recorder_keep WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'annotation', count(*), max(time) FROM ingest.annotation WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour'
) AS c
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Storage
panels.description: Size of each hypertable and continuous aggregate with its indexes, and how many of its chunks are compressed. Raw tables keep 14 or 90 days; the aggregates are kept for good.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT format('%I.%I', h.hypertable_schema, h.hypertable_name) AS "table",
       hypertable_size(format('%I.%I', h.hypertable_schema, h.hypertable_name)::regclass) AS "size",
       count(c.chunk_name) AS "chunks",
       count(c.chunk_name) FILTER (WHERE c.is_compressed) AS "compressed"
FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables AS h
LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.chunks AS c USING (hypertable_schema, hypertable_name)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT format('%I.%I', a.view_schema, a.view_name),
       hypertable_size(format('%I.%I', a.view_schema, a.view_name)::regclass),
       count(c.chunk_name),
       count(c.chunk_name) FILTER (WHERE c.is_compressed)
FROM timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates AS a
LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.chunks AS c
       ON c.hypertable_schema = a.materialization_hypertable_schema
      AND c.hypertable_name = a.materialization_hypertable_name
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Background jobs
panels.description: TimescaleDB's own jobs: aggregate refresh, compression and retention. A failed last run or a growing failure count needs a look at docker compose logs timescaledb.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE j.proc_name WHEN 'policy_refresh_continuous_aggregate' THEN 'refresh'
                        WHEN 'policy_compression' THEN 'compress'
                        WHEN 'policy_retention' THEN 'retention'
                        ELSE j.proc_name END AS "policy",
       coalesce(a.view_schema || '.' || a.view_name,
                j.hypertable_schema || '.' || j.hypertable_name) AS "table",
       s.last_run_status AS "last run",
       s.last_successful_finish AS "last success",
       s.total_failures AS "failures"
FROM timescaledb_information.jobs AS j
LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.job_stats AS s USING (job_id)
LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates AS a
       ON a.materialization_hypertable_schema = j.hypertable_schema
      AND a.materialization_hypertable_name = j.hypertable_name
WHERE j.job_id >= 1000
ORDER BY 2, 1
